question: On a mechanics-enriched, previously unused published slice, does admissible-order reserve 0.15 preserve solves versus production 0.25 while reducing work?
nonDuplication: First campaign arm with a committed pre-execution protocol; earlier arms are retrospective diagnostics.

sampleSelection.rule: rank descending by reqInt*100 + mustCrossCount*30 + mustPassCount*10 + reqLen; tie by original position; take 20
sampleSelection.policyInput: mechanics only; IDs retained solely for output joins, never passed to worker

primaryOutcome: paired solved set; gains and losses symmetric
stoppingRule: run all 20 levels in both arms; no extension or sample replacement
escalationRule: nominate a 100-200-level confirmation only if 0.15 has no net solve loss and either a solve gain or >=5% work reduction among reached levels

protocolVerification.disposition: not independently preregistered; targeted diagnostic only
